citations.detail:
If your covered auto is withdrawn from use for more than 24 consecutive hours
because of a loss covered under Part IV, we will pay reasonable expenses you
incur for a rental vehicle of a class comparable to your covered auto.

We will pay **$40 per day, for a maximum of 30 days** per occurrence.

Coverage begins 24 hours after the loss is reported to us and ends on the
earliest of:

- The day your covered auto is returned to use;
- The day we pay the actual cash value, if the vehicle is a total loss;
- The day the 30-day maximum is reached.

Rental expenses incurred before the loss is reported to us are not covered.
